rows.en: Bernst: "...There's no need to be so wary.
As you can see, I'm unarmed..."
Leone: "Bernst..."
Bernst: "Leone... I'm glad to see you're well.
So you chose them over your father...
How very interesting."
Leone: "You know it too, don't you?!
What Dad's trying to do is wrong!"
Bernst: "Yes. That's why I've come."
Touya: "Just what are you up to?"
Bernst: "Didn't I tell you before?
Touya... I can't have you dying."
Touya: "Quit dodging the question! What do you want?!"
Bernst: "...You really do dislike me.
Well, I suppose that can't be helped...
But you and I are 'comrades'!"
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Bernst: "At present, I am acting
with intentions different from Dr. Debish's. And our objective
of defeating Vorlia is the same as yours."
Ymir: "Huh?"
Bernst: "Does that surprise you? Perhaps it should.
Ever since I joined the Ze=Ode Project,
I devoted everything I had as a researcher
to reviving Vorlia.
But one day, I learned the truth.
Vorlia was nothing more than a device
for integrating humanity's consciousness.
Debish had concealed that even from us
and kept us working on the research.
To be frank, I don't care for it.
Having my own existence forcibly erased,
regardless of my own will."
Touya: "And now you've finally gotten off your ass?"
Bernst: "Yes. You may not believe me,
but my objective is 'Vorlia's destruction.'
There's no point unless I revive it first.
And for that, I needed
more emotional energy.
So I provoked 'hatred,' the strongest
and easiest emotion to create, and accumulated it.
Our Ze=Ode Spirit Mechs are its temporary vessels.
The output of Armored Mechs and Spirit Mechs changes with Prana
because they're imitations of the Ze=Ode Spirit Mechs, which can turn
human will and emotion into energy."
Celica: "...Spirit Mechs were based on Rayblade,
and the mech Armored Mechs were based on no longer exists.
Considering how Agarthia was created,
that explanation does fit.
And you only acted now to avoid repeating
the failure of 109 years ago... Am I wrong?"
Bernst: "Indeed. Wenimas's actions 109 years ago
left me some valuable data.
This time, I can finally put it into practice myself..."
Ai: "Wait. How did you manage
to collect data? And 'finally, yourself'...?
You make it sound like you knew from the start."
Bernst: "Oh, dear. It seems I've let something slip.
Yes, that's right. I knew Wenimas and Lenis
would try to stop it."
Ymir: "!!"
Bernst: "After all, I was the one
who arranged for that data to reach them.
Making the leak look 'natural' took some effort."
Ymir: "D-do you... have no heart!?"
Bernst: "A heart...? I lost mine long ago..."
Ymir: "You... Because of you..."
Bernst: "Thanks to that, you were born in this era.
And to defeat Ze=Ode and Vorlia,
you are using your talents to the full...
Don't you think all of it was the work of 'fate'?
Including my 'jump' here two years before the other four,
which gave me time to prepare."
Ymir: "Y-you..."
Touya: "...Bernst. I told you before.
Even temporarily, I can't join forces with you."
Bernst: "Think more logically.
Fighting Vorlia means fighting Debish as well.
I'm offering to help you in that battle.
If my Gaiozon and your Rayblade worked together,
our chances of victory would improve.
Besides, I gain nothing by lying to you here and now."
Valga: "...That man means what he says.
It seems he has no intention of betraying you either."
Bernst: "You... Were you perhaps the one
piloting that mech before? You 'read' my mind
with that tentacle-like thing..."
Touya: "Whatever you say, I'm not interested.
Like you said, working together
probably would improve our chances.
But I haven't been fighting
just by calculating the odds."
Bernst: "Your comrades...?
So that's the path you've found?"
Touya: "Yeah."
Bernst: "I see... Very well.
It's unfortunate, but I'll give up.
Then, after I defeat you all,
I'll put my own ideas into practice."
Touya: "...Want to try it?"
Bernst: "Hehehe... No, I'll withdraw for today.
Let's settle things the next time we meet.
You and I... Trust and logic... Which is right?"
Bernst: "...Oh, one more thing.
I forgot to mention that you should have
a new visitor soon.
Perhaps I have a duty to witness his final moments...
But I'm rather busy myself..."
Touya: "What do you mean?"
Bernst: "His body can't hold out much longer.
It is only an imitation body, after all...
Well then, I'll be waiting at Alterias Valley..."
Fain: "Whoa, h-he disappeared..."
Touya: "A new visitor...?"
Cain: "Guh... Hah, hah, hah..."
Fain: "Hm? He seems quite different from last time..."
Cain: "What a shame... I was... so close..."
Celica: "Cain! You've done enough! Stop it..."
Cain: "No... I can't... in a place like this... Gah!"
Touya: "Hey... You..."
Cain: "Hah, hah...
To make Lodis pay for his crime,
I'll do anything...
For Rayfon..."
Touya: "You... Why would you go so far...?"
Cain: "Rayfon was everything to me...
He was my goal, the one I admired...
Just having him smile at me made me happy...
I didn't need anything else... Cough!"
Touya: "..."
Cain: "And yet... Even so... That man...
Lodis hurt Rayfon!"
Touya: "...All this over that...?"
Cain: "Well, you wouldn't understand... Hah, hah...
Now, let's settle this..."
Celica: "Cain!"
Cain: "Guh... Hah, hah, hah...
I'll show you the last of my power...
Try protecting it... This royal capital..."
Ai: "Touya, I'm doing things my own way."
Arthur: "I'm sorry, but this time I'll be acting
on my own."
Clovis: "I'm acting independently. I'll leave your side to you."
Aurelie: "Sorry, but I still can't entrust my life to you.
I'll do things my own way."
Xiujian: "...I have no intention of following your orders.
I'll act as I see fit."
Celica: "Sorry, but I can't follow your orders this time."
Fain: "The burning soul of justice
does not yet dwell within you! I cannot obey someone like that!
Therefore, I shall pursue my own justice! That is all!"
Gen: "I'll show you how much I've grown!
So I'm going to act on my own. See you!"
Melvi: "Big Brother, I've got a little idea.
So I'll act on my own."
Melissa: "This time, I'd like to act independently."
Kururu: "I'll fight however I like."
Leone: "I'm not sure I can follow
your orders properly, Touya. So I'll act freely this time."
Cain: "J-just as I thought... This body...
But! It won't end like this! Hehehehehe..."
Cain: "Come, Lodis... Let's go together...
to Rayfon..."
Lodis: "Cain..."
Cain: "Hahahahahaha!
Everyone, disappeaaaaar!!"
Cain: "Hehehe... I-it's too laaaaate!"
Rishuna: "I-I'm putting up a barrier!"
Valga: "Yes!"
Cain: "I'm coming, Rayfon...
And I'm taking the one who hurt you with me..."
Valga: "A-as I thought, acting against Grauzer's will
is a bit too much..."
Rishuna: "Guh..."
Touya: "A-are you okay?!"
Rishuna: "Y-yes..."
Touya: "I see. I'm glad you're safe."
Rishuna: "Huh? Oh... Yeah... Thank you..."
Tix: "Cain... Rayfon's...
alive... And yet...!!"
Cain: "..."
Tix: "Th-that just now..."
